headline: Approved use of Conservation Legacy Fund to acquire property requested by WVPD, 6-0-0.
summary: The board discussed a funding request from WVPD for the Conservation Legacy Fund, including questions about public access and the conservation easement. The board approved the use of the fund for the property acquisition, with continued collaboration on the easement and management plan.
decisions: Approved use of the Conservation Legacy Fund for acquisition of the property requested by WVPD, 6-0-0.

Conservation Board Meeting Minutes 
Monday, July 16, 2026 – 5:30 pm 
Remote Special Meeting 
 
Attendance   
 Board Members: Rebecca Roman (RR), Evan Horne (EH), Zoe Richards (ZR), Dale Azaria (DA), 
Ryan Crehan (RC), Kelly Farrell (KF) 
 Absent: Alan Reichard (AR) 
 Public: Nick Warner, WVPD 
 Staff: Scott Gustin (DPI) 
 
RR, chair, called the meeting to order at 5:32 p.m.  
 
Conservation Legacy Fund 
Consideration of funding request by WVPD 
 
KF, where and when will public access and sensitive habitats be considered?  Nick, we are putting 
together an easement that prioritizes the ecological value but also allows for public access.  The first cut 
is the interim management plan that we’ll present to VHCB.  We’ll build in flexibility.  Vehicle access is 
pretty limited due to the private nature of the access drive.  While we’re in the due diligence period, a 
comprehensive assessment will be done and findings will be shared with the public. 
 
RR, the conservation easement is not yet drafted.  Will there be opportunity for the Conservation Board to 
see and comment on the draft easement and on the management plan?  Nick, yes.  The due diligence 
process will wrap up next month.  Following that, we can move ahead with drafting the easement and 
management plan.  Nick said he’d be ok with review of the drafts in executive session but needs to run 
that by his Board.  The easement informs the management plan.   
 
ZR would be happy to review the easement.  DA and KF agreed.  
 
A MOTION was made by RR and SECONDED by EH: 
 
Approve use of the Conservation Legacy Fund for acquisition of the property as requested in the 
application.  There will be continued collaboration between WVPD and the Conservation Board around 
the conservation easement and the interim management plan.   
 
Vote: 6-0-0, motion carried.  
 
Adjournment 
6:00 PM.
